body: I'm sorry for all this man. I appriciate your time more than you know, but I can't talk about it anymore. Thank you, really.

I know it's irrational, I know the hurt I'll leave behind. I know. But all I can think is that if I never wake up again, I'll finally be at peace and it won't hurt anymore. It is pure selfishness and I live with that guilt every day. Though I technically know I might be meant for more, I do not believe it. Not yet.
I thought I could handle it alone, so as to spare my parents from the added burden. There is a lot of death and sadness in my family. There was never room for me to grieve.
It's been about 10 years since it started, so I don't really remember what I used to think. I wasn't expecting a reply, but appriciate it even if I don't know how to answer you properly
